snippet.title: Spaceman Memories - Official Gameplay Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2025
snippet.description: Check out combat, puzzles, and explore the charming world of Spaceman Memories in this new trailer for the upcoming retro JRPG which takes place in a distant future but draws inspiration from ancient Japanese folktales. Take on the role of Ichiro 94, an astronaut who wakes up from hypersleep to go on a journey to find the remnants of his past. Spaceman Memories will be available on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
